reviewType: Read-only review of existing native diagnostic coverage
runDisposition: Continue the existing authorized run; this report does not request cancellation or an additional run.
overallConclusion: Public failure evidence is asymmetric. A nonzero cause child has a detailed allowlisted startup/exit/stream projection. A nonzero context child has only a narrow authentication-event projection. A nonzero gui child has no failure snapshot. None of these paths retains the actual native-suite child return code as a numeric public field.

exitCodeLayers.publicAvailability: Only the nonzero cause child projection retains browserExitCode/browserSignal plus an availability flag. Status can legitimately remain unavailable if no usable kernel status event was observed. Launcher exit status is not substituted.
Only the nonzero cause child projection retains launcherExitCode. It is a separate process from the browser.

A nonzero result chooses native-cause-exit/native-context-exit/native-gui-exit, but the integer return code is not stored. A child killed by a signal is therefore not distinguishable from a normal nonzero child exit using that field.
summary.stages entry stage=native-suite contains exitCode. Normal handled subtest failures make the wrapper return 1; this is neither the individual harness child code nor the browser code.

cause.configuredInvocation: native_cause.py with the disposable browser, pinned harness, private/cause output and expected build ID; HostProcess launch_services=True.

childNonzero.publicSnapshot: native.firstFailureSnapshot = cause_failure_snapshot(result.json), or {unavailable:true} if the result cannot be read/projected.
retained: allowlisted errorCode, optional numeric errno and diagnostic-incomplete metadata
LaunchServices flag, allowlisted configured switches, about:blank and observed argv-match boolean
environment-name presence booleans, with application environment explicitly UNVERIFIED
launcher/stdout/stderr presence, bytes, bounded head/tail read counts, fixed markers and up to eight numeric OSStatus codes
notRetained: raw output or raw environment/argv/profile values
complete private result or complete raw event history
childNonzero.priorSuccessfulPhaseFields: None; cause is the first subtest and firstCause stays null on this path.

childZeroThenValidationFails.publicErrorCode: native-first-cause-result, a specific read_one failure, or a generic exception type such as KeyError
childZeroThenValidationFails.firstCause: Remains null unless assignment was reached after all validations.
childZeroThenValidationFails.limitation: The detailed cause projection runs only when the child return code is nonzero; a zero-exit but rejected result does not enter it.

cause.onPass: firstCause retains controlled launch-cancelled scenario proof, ownership, kernel Shim exit, cleanup and required build/sandbox identity checks. It does not retain startup streams or browser exit details.

context.configuredInvocation: Pinned test-context-menu.py with the disposable browser, private/context output and iterations=20. The pinned harness uses LaunchServices and a new isolated profile.

retained: last 16 beforeCleanup.shim connected/disconnected events, including typed PID/time/sequence/causeTime fields, allowlisted reason/causeReason and connectedBeforeDisconnect
notRetained: harness phase and sanitized harness error/timeout/codes
streams, including already-sanitized stdout/stderr/log markers and byte counts
kernel observation, Shim lifecycle, crash/system-log summaries and diagnostic errors
requested/attempted iteration counts and partial context-menu delivery results
childNonzero.privateEvidenceIfWritten: The pinned result.json has host process summaries before/after cleanup and sanitized stream/lifecycle data. Raw streams remain under .private-logs; the public wrapper does not copy those summaries.
childNonzero.signalLimitation: The private browserExitCode may encode a signal as a negative integer; the context public snapshot discards it. The private Shim snapshot explicitly reports no wait-status exit code.
childNonzero.truncationLimitation: The public projection keeps 16 events, while truncated reflects the upstream 64-event cap. Dropping events 17 through 64 is not separately marked truncated.
childNonzero.priorSuccessfulPhaseFields: The earlier controlled firstCause proof remains, but it concerns a different host launch/profile and cannot establish this context host's liveness or exit status.

childZeroThenValidationFails.publicErrorCode: context-menu-result, context-diagnostics, context-menu-trusted-events, context-shim-cleanup-exit, a read_one failure, or an exception type
childZeroThenValidationFails.contextMenu: Remains null because context_result assignment did not complete.
childZeroThenValidationFails.limitation: Even a result containing detailed diagnostics is not projected on this path.

context.onPass: contextMenu retains status, attempted=20, trustedContextMenus=20, Shim PID and cleanupKernelExitObserved=true; streams, launch conditions and host exit details are omitted.

gui.configuredInvocation: Pinned test-runtime.py with the disposable browser, private/gui output and --launch-services. No native-input skip, frontend-modules, capture-window or quit-all override is passed; the pinned timeout default is 90 seconds.

notRetained: launchMode, observed host identity/session and browser log locations
stdout/stderr bytes, markers or raw content
childNonzero.privateEvidenceIfWritten: Pinned report.json records phase/error, launchMode and browser log paths, observed host identity/session when reached, and post-cleanup hostExitCode/launcherExitCode or explicit unavailable status. Raw browser streams and child stdout/stderr remain private.
childNonzero.signalLimitation: The private post-cleanup hostExitCode can encode a signal, but no separate browserSignal/requestedSignal pair is projected; the wrapper does not read the report at all when code is nonzero.
childNonzero.priorSuccessfulPhaseFields: Earlier cause/context proofs belong to separate host launches/profiles and cannot be treated as diagnostics for this gui host.

childZeroThenValidationFails.publicErrorCode: native-gui-result, a read_one failure, or an exception type
childZeroThenValidationFails.limitation: The report is read, but its phase/error/host/stream data is still not copied into public summary.

gui.onPass: gui retains only status=passed and nativeInputSkipped=false after required native input match/event checks.

crossPhaseLimits: firstCause is a controlled authenticated Shim cancellation proof, not the root cause of a later context/gui failure.

Subtest stdout and stderr are merged into private cause/context/gui.private.log files. The wrapper does not publish their contents. summary.stages.native-suite.logBytes describes the wrapper log, not browser stdout/stderr.

If native-summary.json is missing or unreadable, or the outer wrapper is terminated before it can write the file, pipeline cannot reconstruct per-subtest diagnostics from private result files. It only conditionally loads native-summary.json below 65536 bytes.
Snapshot creation is limited to nonzero cause/context children. Early wrapper launch/environment/file errors and code-zero validation failures can retain only a coarse error code.
Missing diagnostic coverage is not an alternate success path: the existing validations still fail the wrapper when required subtests or result checks fail.

availablePublicEvidenceIfResultWritten: browser code/signal if a usable event was observed, otherwise explicit unavailable
configured startup flags and before/after requested-signal distinction
bounded allowlisted startup stream markers and OSStatus codes
originalFailureReobservation.whyNotGuaranteed: A browser can exit before adoption or without an exit-status event, and arbitrary loader/assertion/error text is deliberately not published. Exit status alone also does not prove a root cause. The fixed marker set can identify only the covered failure signatures.
originalFailureReobservation.laterContextOrGuiHostExit: Current public projections do not carry the browser exit/stream/launch evidence needed to diagnose an analogous host exit in those later phases.
originalFailureReobservation.terminalCollectionInterpretation: Use the phase-specific native error/snapshot and outer stage/cleanup/monitor evidence as distinct layers. Report insufficient evidence when status or markers are unavailable; do not infer browser signal, authentication completion or a root cause from wrapper exitCode or from an earlier firstCause pass.
